articles.summary: Nearly a year after filing their merger application with the Surface Transportation Board (STB), Union Pacific (NYSE: UNP) CEO Jim Vena and Norfolk Southern (NYSE: NSC) CEO and President Mark George said engagement with the railroads’ stakeholders has reinforced a consistent message: rail must become simpler, more reliable and easier to do business with if it is going to win more freight from America's highways.
articles.title: Union Pacific and Norfolk Southern CEOs: A Year of Listening Reinforces the Need for a Simpler, More Competitive Rail Network

articles.summary: Union Pacific (NYSE: UNP) and Norfolk Southern (NYSE: NSC) today filed their response to Canadian Pacific Kansas City’s request that the Surface Transportation Board (STB) terminate review of the proposed transcontinental railroad, which will be the nation’s first single-line, seamless coast-to-coast railroad.
articles.title: Union Pacific and Norfolk Southern Look Forward to a Full Evaluation of Merger Application

articles.summary: The Board of Directors of Union Pacific Corporation (NYSE: UNP) has declared a quarterly dividend of $1.42 per share on the company’s common stock, payable Dec. 30, 2026, to shareholders of record Dec. 4, 2026.
articles.title: Union Pacific Corporation Declares Fourth Quarter 2026 Dividend

articles.summary: Union Pacific’s Big Boy No. 4014 and Living Legend No. 844, the world’s largest and fastest operating steam locomotives respectively, will make two public appearances in Colorado this weekend as part of their first-ever holiday excursion.
articles.title: Union Pacific’s Steam Legends Return to the Rails for Holiday Excursion in Colorado
